results.warning_note: Four pre-existing StoreKit UI test setup actor-isolation warnings; wrapper repeats some diagnostics. No runtime warnings.

totals.note: Eight unique focused cases: two earlier Home cases plus six Settings cases. The final two-case follow-up repeats Settings cases and is not added again. These are focused runs, not a full-suite run.

changes: Render the horizontal time range as one Text while preserving locale, calendar, time zone, vertical fallback and next-day marker.
Lay out the existing Settings Sections in a regular grouped ScrollView/VStack so complete row and footer text determines their height.
Use one wrapping Text menu label for reminder values, retaining native menu selection and accessible title/value.
Keep the current section when Dynamic Type changes, using stable row/header/footer identities captured only during user scrolling and only when at least half visible.
Keep explicit native picker semantics, full button hit regions, disclosure indicators, accent-colored reminder values and the destructive erase label.
visual_inspection: Root inspected the earlier accepted Home captures, plus final English/Norwegian Settings, largest Norwegian cloud section after the font sweep, the complete largest English reminder value after the sweep, ordinary reminder controls, weight-unit selection, and data/navigation captures. The final color-refinement captures show the full accent-colored reminder value and red erase label. Normal scroll viewport boundaries are distinct from text truncation.

source_identity.note: Fingerprints describe final retained source. Temporary diagnostic code was removed. The last two production edits only restored reminder/erase control colors and were covered by the successful two-case follow-up.

earlier_evidence: release/accessibility-verified.json retains the morning failures and model/setup results. Those suites were not repeated in this UI-only follow-up.
archive_scope: The earlier signed archive 2449.6.4 predates these changes. No replacement archive, build upload or review submission was made.
hardware_scope: Simulator validation. No claim of final physical-device, multi-iPhone, TestFlight or App Review approval.

rejected_candidates.scope: Full Settings: ordinary English, ordinary Norwegian, largest Norwegian, largest English reminders
rejected_candidates.rejected_reason: Post-audit viewport regression: recreating the full Form made cloudSyncHelp disappear and reset scrolling. Native passes do not count as accepted remediation.
Native reminder picker passed its audit but visibly shortened the largest selected value to planned; replaced by one wrapping Text menu label.
isHittable passed but the reminder screenshot showed only its help footer. Rejected after visual inspection; increased visibility threshold and added a real post-audit menu interaction.

settings_production_state: Grouped Settings scroll view, wrapping reminder menu values and user-scroll target preservation retained. No full-screen identity reset, audit issue handler, filter or waiver.

diagnostics.all_eight_section_isolations: passed; this does not replace the failed full-Form tests
reverted_trials: whole Form identity based on Dynamic Type
help text moved from footer into rows
diagnostics.settling_probe: A 50-second pause before the native audit still failed. Temporary pause removed.
diagnostics.tooling_limit: Accessibility Inspector could not attach through current UI controls; Device Hub timed out. This does not prove an Apple framework defect or a false positive.
diagnostics.initial_final_run_error: The first retained-source command used the wrong test target and ran zero tests; it is excluded from results. The corrected final run executed all four tests.
diagnostics.earlier_settings_production_state: The 15 September retained-source run still had four failures; those are preserved in earlier_results.
diagnostics.september_16_findings: The full native Form reproduced the targetless report while a regular grouped stack cleared it. This comparison does not prove an Apple framework defect. A native menu Picker passed its audit but visibly truncated the selected value, and a barely-visible footer target moved the reminder out of view; both candidates were rejected.

earlier_results.scope: Final retained full Settings: ordinary English, ordinary Norwegian, largest Norwegian, largest English reminders
earlier_results.failure: All four native audits report Text clipped. No resolvable target identified.

verification_followups.scope: Final control-color refinement: largest reminder menu and weight/sync/navigation. Both cases repeated successfully after giving reminder values the accent color and the erase label its destructive color.
